name: PT Soechi Lines Tbk
summary: PT Soechi Lines Tbk provides shipping and shipyard services in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments, Shipping Business, and Shipyard Business. It offers transportation services for oil, gas, and chemicals; and ship maintenance, repair and overhauling vessels, new shipbuilding, and dry docking services. The company also provides management and business consulting services; and business brokerage services, as well as brokers consulting services. It owns and operates a fleet of 30 vessels. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Soechi Lines Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Soechi Group.
